title: 22 October 2015: Paul McCartney live at First Niagara Center, Buffalo, NY
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the First Niagara Center in Buffalo, New York, USA, on 22 October 2015.

Flags in Buffalo #OutThere pic.twitter.com/GJV5hjcNfg

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 23, 2015

It was the final show of the Out There Tour, which lasted for 91 dates between May 2013 and October 2015.

Mr. Kite rocking his lasers #OutThere pic.twitter.com/k559ikVU6Q

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 23, 2015

Paul hugs fan at Buffalo show #OutThere pic.twitter.com/rL0eIZ0HfM

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 23, 2015

As is customary at McCartney’s concerts, he invited a selection of lucky (and clearly nervous) fans bearing signs onto the stage.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

End of tour, on the bus, thanks guys! #OutThere pic.twitter.com/lUIB0iZun1

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 23, 2015

Yes indeed. Thanks to all who made it happen. (puts on best American accent) "You Rock"… https://t.co/38U2rz9bpG

— Paul Wickens (@WixWickens) October 24, 2015

@brianrayguitar @PaulMcCartney @ogabejr @WixWickens @rustyanderson1 You guys made my year. Thank you! ??from?? pic.twitter.com/DCP8LNlUc6

— ????????@Niaga ecin tuo denrut (@minky505) October 28, 2015
